## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking, ungainly man with long iron-gray hair that reaches his stooping shoulders. He also sports a full, soft brown beard, which he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally quiet, shy, and good-natured man who avoids excitement and rarely volunteers information or engages in arguments. Despite his intense shyness around strangers and a deep-seated dread of women and little girls, whom he fears are secretly laughing at him, he is a deeply sympathetic and indulgent listener. He is known for his patient and persistent nature, quietly holding fast to his opinions once formed. Though noted for being unobservant and hardworking, he possesses a wise and kind demeanor that earns admiration. He famously wished to keep [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), offering her a loving and supportive presence.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert was an extremely shy man who dreaded almost all women except his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Due to his quiet nature, he rarely left home, and local boys found it difficult to get acquainted with him. When Matthew went to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station to pick up an orphan boy to help on the farm, he was surprised to find a talkative young girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) instead. Although [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intended to send [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back, Matthew gently advocated for keeping her. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settled into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Matthew showed her quiet kindness, bringing her sweeties and offering warm encouragement for her schoolwork. Observing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacked stylish clothing like her peers, he sought the help of Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to secure a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift. Over the years, he took immense pride in Anne's academic achievements, including her entrance into Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and her winning of the Avery Scholarship. Following Anne's return home, Matthew's health began to fail. Shortly thereafter, he suffered a fatal collapse after reading news of a bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to mourn his loss.

## Quotes

> "I reckon she ought to be punished a little. But don’t be too hard on her, Marilla. Recollect she hasn’t ever had anyone to teach her right. You’re—you’re going to give her something to eat, aren’t you?"
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "That’s right—that’s right, Anne. But don’t tell Marilla I said anything about it. She might think I was putting my oar in and I promised not to do that."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

> “Well now, you’ll have to punish her,” said Matthew, reaching for his hat. “I’ve nothing to do with it, remember. You warned me off yourself.”
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025)

> “Well now, I guess you’ll manage all right,” said Matthew, looking at Anne’s white little face and the dark shadows under her eyes. “You just go right to bed and have a good sleep. I’ll do all the chores.”
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are the best of friends, forming an immediate connection when he brings her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Despite Marilla's initial shock at receiving a girl instead of a boy, Matthew quietly advocates for keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and continues to show his support through small gestures like bringing her sweeties. He acts as a gentle ally, even visiting her secretly to persuade her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can end her punishment.

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/matthew-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a trusted neighbor who keeps a close eye on Matthew and the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) household, offering advice and help such as making a dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship involves regular neighborhood interactions, starting when [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots a dressed-up Matthew driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate. Over time, she acts as a supportive adviser during family crises, including times when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets into trouble.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +6 more_
